quick_skim.title: On a bulk-surface Navier-Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard model: Existence of weak solutions and asymptotic limits
quick_skim.abstract: We study a thermodynamically consistent bulk-surface Navier--Stokes--Cahn--Hilliard system describing two-phase flows exhibiting moving contact lines, variable contact angles, and mass transfer. We establish the existence of global weak solutions for non-degenerate mobility functions and singular free-energy potentials. The proof is based on an implicit time-discretization scheme and a subdifferential characterization of the convex part of the bulk-surface free energy. Finally, we study the simultaneous high-friction and decoupling limit, and prove that corresponding weak solutions converge, up to a subsequence, to a weak solution of the Abels--Garcke--Grün model. One key ingredient of the proof is the Mosco convergence of the convex part of the bulk-surface free energy, which might be of independent interest.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Studies a bulk-surface Navier-Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard system for two-phase flows with moving contact lines, variable contact angles, and mass transfer; establishes global weak solutions and asymptotic limits.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该论文研究热力学一致的体-表面纳维-斯托克斯-卡恩-希利亚德系统，该系统描述具有移动接触线、可变接触角和传质的两相流。作者采用隐式时间离散格式和次微分刻画凸部分自由能，证明了非退化迁移率函数和奇异自由能势下全局弱解的存在性。进一步研究了同时高摩擦和去耦合极限，证明相应弱解收敛到Abels-Garcke-Grün模型的弱解。这项工作为复杂两相流与传质耦合的数值模拟提供了坚实的数学基础，对理解降膜等过程中的界面现象具有参考价值。
